name: Xtend AI Robotics, Inc.
summary: Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. designs and develops artificial intelligence-powered robotics and autonomous systems for defense, homeland security, and commercial security applications. The company's core platform, XOS (XTEND Operating System), connects autonomous platforms, AI, and operators into one intelligent software foundation for coordinated missions across air, ground, and maritime domains.
